one_month_reasoning: No TT earnings in the window (Q4 reports late January 2027). Events to 2026-11-29: the US midterm election (Nov 3), October CPI (mid-November), peer read-across already out (JCI reported fiscal Q4 on Oct 27, LII/AAON earlier), so no peer print of note in the window and any hyperscaler capex commentary. The stock fell 8.6% (448.47 -> 410.00) on a revenue/bookings beat with only a reaffirmed EPS guide: implied Q4 EPS 3.40-3.50 vs the still-stale $3.59 Street (Nasdaq), FY price cut to ~1pt and leverage to low-20s. Negative post-guidance drift (estimates still to fall ~3-5% for Q4) roughly offsets short-term reversal after a sharp gap down near the 52-week range middle, so I centre slightly above spot (411.5) with the usual monthly vol 30%/3.5 = 8.6%, widened to 8.8% for post-earnings drift uncertainty.

fair_value.method: Quarterly segment build: FY27 revenue $26.8B (+10.6%), GAAP EBIT $4.99B (18.6%), FY28 $28.9B / $5.49B; NTM (Q4'27-Q3'28) model GAAP EPS ~$19.5 at 22.7x P/E (w 0.75) and LTM GAAP EBITDA at 19.0x (w 0.25), less net debt incl. supplier finance, NCI at market and the asbestos plan balance, shares -1.8%/yr; engine base horizon value $442.9.

downside.story: 10th percentile: hyperscaler capex digestion in 2027 pauses data-center orders (Americas commercial book-to-bill under 1 for 2-3 quarters), residential stays soft, lead-time pricing fades: Americas revenue -7% vs base (FY27 ~+3%), Americas margin -200bp, EMEA -4%/-150bp, APAC -3%; the multiple falls 4 turns to ~18.7x P/E, the whole-company peer median (18.3x) with almost no premium left.

base.story: Median: backlog burns on schedule (FY27 +10.6%, FY28 +7.8%), ~23.8% reported incrementals, FY27 model GAAP EPS ~$17.83 (Street $17.71, whisper $18.10; adjusted ~$18.1), exit P/E 22.7x on NTM ~$19.5, bridge with supplier finance, NCI at market and asbestos.

upside.story: 90th percentile: backlog burns faster (supply constraints clear in 1H27), data-center and applied orders keep growing, 25%+ incrementals return: Americas revenue +6% vs base (FY27 ~+17%), margin +100bp, EMEA +3%/+50bp; the multiple holds near today's ~26x NTM P/E as FY28 visibility extends.

key_uncertainties: Duration of the data-center build: >$8B of backlog dated 2027+ but orders are 'lumpy' and >90% of the 1,700 tracked mega-projects are data centers (concentration).
Incremental margins: FY26 leverage cut to low-20s; Stellar and bolt-ons are mid-teens margin; price only +20-30bp over inflation in 2027.
Residential recovery vs rates; refrigerant 454B transition effects normalise in 2027.
EMEA Middle East conflict and China weakness in Asia Pacific.
Multiple: TT trades at ~23.9x NTM vs the 18.3x whole-company HVAC median; a de-rate to the median alone is -24%.
Asbestos: the Aldrich/Murray estimation hearing (phase 1 from Aug 2026) could set a liability above the $545M proposed plan; no figure is public in the filings read.

reverse_dcf_check: 22.7x NTM P/E at the horizon on ~$19.5 model GAAP EPS (Q4'27-Q3'28) implies roughly 9-10% EPS growth for ~5 years after FY2028 with GAAP operating margins holding ~19%: data-center/applied demand normalising to replacement plus secular decarbonisation growth rather than collapsing; a 2028-29 data-center digestion is priced by the market in that multiple, not on top of it.

sbc_treatment.note: Counted once, as a cost: GAAP EBIT (after SBC, F43 $86.6M FY25) in the build and GAAP-basis model EPS; the share count falls by gross buybacks only (-1.8%/yr: 3.0M shares bought in 9M26 for $1,338.5M, 10-Q), with SBC share issuance not netted again (round 1 netted ~0.6M SBC shares, a double count). Peers' consensus EPS keeps SBC expensed, so the basis matches.

reasoning: Round 2. Filings first: Q3'26 revenue $6,760M (+18%), bookings $7,248M, backlog $12.5B (+73%), EMEA/APAC margins down, FY EPS guide only reaffirmed; the call put Q4 adjusted EPS at $3.40-3.50 (incl. 10c tax) vs a $3.59 Street, cut FY price to ~1pt and FY organic leverage to 'low 20s' (from 25%+) - why the beat sold off 8.6%. >$8B of the $12.5B backlog is for 2027+ and >$1B for 2028, so FY27 Americas +11% is largely booked. Supervisor findings acted on: (1) peer median rebuilt on 6 whole-company peers (CSW dropped): 18.3x on the peers.md figures (supervisor 18.45x on Nasdaq quarterly peer EPS); own NTM 23.93x on post-print consensus; exit 22.7x, no -0.5 turn (it double counted the k=0.8 shrink on a market-priced multiple). (2) Net debt now includes supplier finance $393.1M (10-Q, in accounts payable): 3,383.3. (3) NCI at market (-488: 9M NCI earnings $20.0M annualised x 18.3x) and the asbestos plan balance (-275 = $545M plan - $270M QSF, 10-K) as adjustments; the supervisor's extra -197.5 x 0.4 court estimate is not in the 10-K and is left out. (4) SBC counted once: share count -1.8%/yr on gross buybacks. (5) EV/EBITDA cross-check on whole-company filers only: 14.1x median, exit 19.0x. (6) JCI's print was Oct 27, outside the 1-month window. Where I disagree: the supervisor says 'Q4 incrementals north of 25%' is not in the transcript; the TradingKey transcript (source 4) has the CEO saying 'our incremental leverage in the fourth quarter, we're projecting to be north of our target range' (target 25%+) - I re-cite it to source 4 and keep it, while taking the FY 'low 20s' cut into the Americas path (+30bp FY27, ~23.8% reported incrementals). Tax 18.5% FY26 / 19.5% FY27-28 (was 20%). Model FY27 GAAP EPS $17.83 vs Street $17.71 and whisper $18.10 (adjusted ~$18.1). Guidance record: every first annual EPS guide FY23-26 beaten (median +5.8%); FY26 incremental target missed. The net effect of the fixes is small (443.6 -> 442.9): removing the haircut, the lower tax and the share count lift the P/E leg, supplier finance/NCI/asbestos and the lower EV/EBITDA multiple take it back. Downside (P10) = data-center order pause + margin -200bp + de-rate to the peer median; upside (P90) = faster burn, 25%+ incrementals, multiple held. sec.gov refuses scripted access without a contact email, so filings were read with WebFetch. All legs driver-linked; no custom legs.
